; PROBE (temporary): dump ArkTokens.BatteryIndicator so the black style can
; hand ark's battery drawing a color-swapped token clone (v0.42 option C).
; Also answers whether the COMPILED ArkControls.BatteryIndicator wrapper
; forwards `type` as an assignable var — if not, the clone must target the
; inner BatteryIcon (plain QML in ark.controls) instead of the wrapper.
; Navigator.qml already imports ark.tokens/ark.controls with these aliases,
; so no IMPORT is needed. Removed after the journal read.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: battTokProbe
				visible: false

				function dump(name, o, depth) {
					if (o === null || o === undefined) {
						console.log("BATTPROBE " + name + " = " + o);
						return;
					}
					if (depth > 4) return;
					var seen = false;
					for (var k in o) {
						seen = true;
						var v = o[k];
						if (v !== null && typeof v === "object") {
							battTokProbe.dump(name + "." + k, v, depth + 1);
						} else if (typeof v !== "function") {
							console.log("BATTPROBE " + name + "." + k + " = " + v);
						}
					}
					if (!seen)
						console.log("BATTPROBE " + name + " : no enumerable keys (" + o + ")");
				}

				// same four properties the mod's own live instance sets — a
				// device-proven instantiation of the compiled wrapper
				ArkControls.BatteryIndicator {
					id: battTokProbeInd
					visible: false
					value: 42
					showCharging: false
					showWarning: false
					showValue: false
				}

				Timer {
					interval: 6000
					running: true
					onTriggered: {
						try {
							battTokProbe.dump("tokens.BatteryIndicator",
								ArkTokens.BatteryIndicator, 0);
						} catch (e) { console.log("BATTPROBE tokens threw " + e); }
						try {
							console.log("BATTPROBE wrapper.type typeof="
								+ (typeof battTokProbeInd.type));
							if (battTokProbeInd.type !== undefined)
								battTokProbe.dump("wrapper.type", battTokProbeInd.type, 3);
						} catch (e) { console.log("BATTPROBE wrapper read threw " + e); }
						try {
							var orig = battTokProbeInd.type;
							battTokProbeInd.type = { pinSleepProbe: 1 };
							var ok = battTokProbeInd.type
								&& battTokProbeInd.type.pinSleepProbe === 1;
							battTokProbeInd.type = orig;
							console.log("BATTPROBE wrapper.type assignable=" + ok);
						} catch (e) { console.log("BATTPROBE wrapper assign threw " + e); }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
